semantics.definition: The icon set: 27 stroke icons drawn on a 20-unit grid, in the colour of the text around them.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one icons every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Show a small picture of an action or a thing. A new icon is a new version of this meron.

name.right: pointing right: on, or open a row
name.down: pointing down: an open row, a list that opens
name.up-right: up and to the right, at 45 degrees: a link to a place
name.check: a tick in a circle: success
name.tick: a tick: a checkbox that is on
name.x: a cross in a circle: danger, or no
name.warn: a triangle with a mark: warning
name.dash: a line in a circle: not yet, or does not apply
name.arrow: an arrow to the right: go on
name.fit: four corners: fit to the window
name.layers: stacked layers: a system or a group
name.doc: a page: a document or an invariant
name.theme: a half-filled circle: light or dark
